title: Maybe You Should Talk to Someone: A Therapist, Her Therapist, and Our Lives Revealed

updated.markText: Don’t judge your feelings; notice them. Use them as your map. Don’t be afraid of the truth.
Over the years, I’ve handed tissue boxes to patients countless times, but I’d forgotten how cared for that simple gesture can make someone feel.
